movesets.name: Boots Attacker
movesets.description:
Keldeo is a great offensive Water-type for balance and bulky offense teams, finding a niche over similar offensive Water-types like Walking Wake and Ogerpon-W thanks to its Fighting typing and access to Vacuum Wave. Aura Sphere is preferred over Secret Sword, as it allows Keldeo to break past Alomomola, but Secret Sword can be used to do more damage to some special walls like Ting-Lu and Blissey. Vacuum Wave is an amazing move, giving Keldeo the ability to pick off many Pokemon including Kingambit, Darkrai, Weavile, and Meowscarada. Flip Turn rounds out its moveset as a very safe option to maintain momentum, but it is notably punishable by Ogerpon-W. Tera Water boosts the power of Surf and sheds its Fairy weakness, allowing it to pick off Iron Valiant and Clefable and secure an OHKO on specially defensive Gliscor after Stealth Rock.

Keldeo fits on balance and bulky offense teams that appreciate its wallbreaking capabilities. Hazard stacking cores are essential to Keldeo teams, as it often finds itself unable to break bulkier teams on its own when Heavy-Duty Boots are intact or hazards remain off the field. Gliscor fits especially well with Keldeo when running Knock Off + Swords Dance sets, as it provides a great wincon into bulky teams while appreciating Keldeo's ability to heavily threaten offensive teams that can overwhelm Gliscor with direct damage. Gliscor and Ting-Lu are both immune to Electric, guarding Keldeo from threats like Zapdos and Raging Bolt, while Skarmory can check physical threats attempting to use Keldeo as safe entry point like Ogerpon-W and Dragonite. All three Spikes users appreciate Keldeo pressuring Spikes-immune Pokemon like Gliscor and Clefable and Keldeo's ability to use Flip Turn against its counters like Alomomola and Galarian Slowking to give good opportunities for them to set up Spikes. Stealth Rock users like Clefable, Tinkaton, and Ting-Lu are also crucial to ensure maximum damage from entry hazards. Tinkaton in particular is amazing, as its Fairy / Steel typing allows it to check Pokemon that heavily threaten Keldeo like Hatterene, Iron Valiant, and Kyurem if its Air Balloon is still intact, while its Encore serves as a backup check to Kingambit if it uses Tera Ghost on Keldeo's Vacuum Wave. Tinkaton loves Keldeo threatening Ground- and Fire-types like Great Tusk, Moltres, and Cinderace that heavily threaten it. Knock Off users complete hazard cores by removing Heavy-Duty Boots for Keldeo, and Knock Off users that synergize with Keldeo include Clefable and Weavile. Keldeo appreciates how Weavile and Calm Mind + Knock Off Clefable can wear down defensive cores featuring Pokemon like Alomomola, Primarina, and Toxapex. Ogerpon-W is a huge threat for Keldeo, as its Water immunity, access to Knock Off, and higher base Speed can easily lead to Ogerpon-W offensively overwhelming Keldeo and winning the game. To counteract this, Ogerpon-W answers like Dragonite, Dragapult, Pecharunt, and Zamazenta are greatly appreciated. Dragonite is an especially good partner, as its Extreme Speed covers threats that Keldeo cannot revenge kill with Vacuum Wave such as Iron Valiant and Iron Moth, while Keldeo provides a check to Weavile and threatens bulky Ground-types like Gliscor, Ting-Lu, and Great Tusk. All-out attacking Zamazenta provides excellent speed control, appreciates Keldeo wearing down Dragapult, and is a massive threat for offense teams that can overwhelm Keldeo. Sinistcha, Pecharunt, and Dragapult can help Keldeo by being solid spinblockers, allowing hazards to stay up so Keldeo can threaten bulkier cores featuring Pokemon like Assault Vest Primarina, Assault Vest Alomomola, and Toxapex. Sinistcha can additionally serve as a potent win condition that finds opportunities to set up Calm Mind on Water-types Keldeo draws in, while Pecharunt can bring Keldeo in by pivoting out of Ground-types like Ting-Lu and Gliscor and check Pokemon like Ogerpon-W and Dragonite for Keldeo. Pecharunt also appreciates Keldeo's ability to threaten the aforementioned Dark-types and provides an answer to Iron Valiant without Shadow Ball, Dragonite, and Ogerpon-W. Most Dragapult sets are major threats to bulkier teams that Keldeo can struggle with, and it appreciates Keldeo being able to threaten Dark-types like Hisuian Samurott, Ting-Lu, and Kingambit.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description:
Choice Specs Keldeo is an effective wallbreaker that can leverage its high Special Attack, decent Speed, and unique STAB move options to break holes into the opposition. Surf is usually preferred for its higher accuracy, but Hydro Pump can be chosen to get a guaranteed OHKO on Enamorus, a chance to OHKO Gholdengo, and a guaranteed OHKO on Hatterene after Stealth Rock. Both Secret Sword and Aura Sphere OHKO threats like Kyurem, Darkrai, Hisuian Samurott, Weavile, and Kingambit. Secret Sword also yields great damage against Blissey, Tera Dark or Steel Clodsire, Tera Water Ogerpon-W, and Assault Vest Iron Crown, while Aura Sphere hits defensive Alomomola and Dondozo significantly harder than Secret Sword would. Vacuum Wave grants Keldeo the opportunity to pick off weakened and faster foes like Raging Bolt, Darkrai, Weavile, and Dragon Dance-boosted Kyurem; it also gives Keldeo an edge over Kingambit trying to use Sucker Punch. Flip Turn allows Keldeo to pivot out of unfavorable matchups like Primarina, Alomomola, Toxapex, and Dragonite. Icy Wind directly threatens switch-ins like Dragonite, Dragapult, and Hydrapple. Tera Water is usually preferred, as it can give a chance to OHKO targets like Garganacl and Enamorus with Surf while also removing Keldeo's Fairy weakness for the latter. Tera Water lets Hydro Pump OHKO Pecharunt, Zapdos, offensive Zamazenta, Clefable, and Ting-Lu. Tera Fighting gives a Keldeo the opportunity to OHKO Ogerpon-W with Secret Sword and Darkrai with Vacuum Wave. Tera Blast Electric can be used to target foes like Assault Vest Alomomola, Primarina, and Dondozo.

This particular Keldeo set finds its niche on bulky offense teams that appreciate its ability to threaten key defensive Pokemon like Ting-Lu, Gliscor, and Moltres. Keldeo appreciates teammates that bring it in safely to effectively wallbreak or handle foes such as Iron Valiant, Dragapult, and Choice Scarf Enamorus, which outpace and threaten it. In addition to pivoting, Galarian Slowking can provide a reliable answer to threats such as Iron Valiant and Choice Scarf Enamorus. It also provides Future Sight, which discourages checks like Toxapex from coming in on Keldeo. Zapdos provides a defensive answer to Grass-type Pokemon that look to revenge kill Keldeo. Dragapult is an effective teammate for Keldeo, as it can bring Keldeo in versus Garganacl and Ting-Lu and take on foes that try to advantage of a Choice-locked Keldeo, like Raging Bolt, Dragonite, and Kyurem. Garganacl and Ting-Lu can serve as effective partners due to their ability to answer Dragapult. Choice Scarf Gholdengo can provide speed control and cripple walls with Trick, pressuring common defensive cores in conjunction with Keldeo's offensive prowess. Dragonite can help answer Ogerpon-W for Keldeo; in return, Keldeo can punch through walls like Corviknight and Ting-Lu for Dragonite. Keldeo also appreciates entry hazard support from partners like Ting-Lu, Tinkaton, Iron Treads, and Great Tusk to further enhance its wallbreaking opportunities, reaching feats such as a guaranteed OHKO on Garganacl with Surf after Stealth Rock. Keldeo can easily be worn down by hazards; therefore, it values entry hazard removal from allies like Great Tusk, Iron Treads, and Corviknight.

movesets.name: Choice Specs (Water)
movesets.description:
Choice Specs Keldeo is a formidable wallbreaker for Water teams, easily dismantling Flying and Steel defensive cores without setup, which makes it terrifying from the get-go. Hydro Pump 2HKOes popular walls such as specially defensive Corviknight and Gholdengo. Surf is an alternative that ensures consistency against Pokemon with Pressure. Secret Sword sets Keldeo apart from other Water-type attackers by allowing Keldeo to OHKO specially defensive targets such as Hisuian Goodra and to 2HKO Articuno and Alolan Muk. Vacuum Wave can pick off weakened foes such as Roaring Moon, Excadrill, and Meowscarada. Lastly, Icy Wind targets Dragonite and prevents popular Choice Specs users like Dragapult and Latios from switching into Keldeo.

Keldeo appreciates entry hazard setters such as Swampert and Gastrodon, as they bolster Keldeo's attacking prowess and are immune to Electric. Swampert can also run utility moves such as Knock Off and Flip Turn, which makes it the ideal partner to maintain pressure. Toxapex provides a useful Fairy-resistant option for Flutter Mane's Moonblast, removes Toxic Spikes from the field, and has access to utility options such as Toxic, Toxic Spikes, and Haze to support Keldeo. Hisuian Samurott can set up Spikes, provides a useful Psychic immunity, and can remove foes such as Dragapult and Latios with Sucker Punch, which reduces the need for prediction on Keldeo's part. Other excellent offensive teammates include Ogerpon-W and Greninja; Ogerpon-W can deal with Water Absorb Clodsire, Azumarill, and Primarina against which Keldeo is powerless, and Greninja can address any issue Keldeo faces thanks to its huge offensive movepool. Greninja's Sludge Wave hits Grass- and Fairy-types that handle Keldeo like the Ogerpon formes, Primarina, and Iron Valiant, while Extrasensory and Ice Beam can deal with Poison-, Flying-, and Dragon-types. Finally, Keldeo appreciates rain from Drizzle Pelipper, as it allows Hydro Pump to OHKO defensive Gholdengo and Corviknight, while Pelipper's Hurricane can deal with Grass-type foes such as Rillaboom and Amoonguss.

movesets.name: Calm Mind (Water)
movesets.description:
With Calm Mind, Keldeo turns into a great sweeper that can threaten foes both physically and specially. Vacuum Wave is a strong STAB priority option to pick off faster albeit weakened threats like Meowscarada, Greninja, and Choice Scarf Hydreigon. Surf is highly accurate, targeting slower threats like non-Choice Scarf Landorus and Gliscor, while Hydro Pump, although it has lower accuracy, brings more power, notably 2HKOing physically defensive Corviknight. Secret Sword threatens special walls that Keldeo's other moves do not; it OHKOes Assault Vest Hisuian Goodra and 2HKOes Alolan Muk after a Calm Mind boost. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Keldeo to switch in safely regardless of entry hazards, while Leftovers grants Keldeo a small form of longevity.

Swampert and Gastrodon make for good teammates, as they set up entry hazards that can help Keldeo sweep, and they also both provide an immunity against Electric-types like Magnezone and Regieleki. In return, Keldeo threatens Choice Specs Kyurem for them. Toxapex is another great defensive partner, threatening Fairy-types like Iron Valiant and Enamorus with Sludge Bomb; it also absorbs Toxic Spikes for Keldeo when Keldeo isn't running Heavy-Duty Boots. In return, Keldeo handles Ground-types that threaten Toxapex such as Ursaluna and Landorus. Choice Scarf Hisuian Samurott outspeeds Pokemon that can shrug off Keldeo's STAB moves, such as Latios and Dragapult, while easily setting up Spikes with Ceaseless Edge. Greninja makes for another great partner, as it outspeeds and threatens the likes of Iron Valiant, Primarina, and the Ogerpon formes with Sludge Wave. In return, Keldeo threatens Hisuian Goodra for it. Ogerpon-W forms an offensive core with Keldeo. It checks Water Absorb Clodsire, Azumarill, and Primarina, while Keldeo threatens Archaludon.

movesets.name: Choice Specs (Fighting)
movesets.description:
Equipped with Choice Specs, Keldeo makes for a strong wallbreaker on Fighting teams, threatening the likes of Great Tusk and Gliscor with Hydro Pump and outspeeding both Landorus formes and Garchomp. With Secret Sword, Keldeo is able to threaten foes physically and specially; thus, walls that would normally switch into one of Keldeo's other attacks, such as Alolan Muk, Hisuian Goodra, and Articuno, take high damage from it. Vacuum Wave serves as a strong revenge killing option for Keldeo, picking off faster weakened threats like Greninja and Excadrill and KOing Meowscarada after Stealth Rock damage with ease. Icy Wind grants Keldeo coverage against Dragon-types, and with the Speed drop, it is able to counter Dragon Dance attempts from Garchomp. Surf is a great Water-type STAB move that, although weaker than Hydro Pump, has greater accuracy.

Great Tusk is an almost-universal choice for a partner for Keldeo, both setting up Stealth Rock to wear down incoming foes and removing entry hazards with Rapid Spin so Keldeo can switch in safely. Great Tusk also provides an Electric immunity for Keldeo, and it can take out the likes of Iron Hands, Toxapex, and Water Absorb Clodsire. Iron Hands grants Fighting teams coverage against Flying teams, and with its bulk and movepool, it is able to remove the likes of Gyarados, Tornadus-T, and Enamorus. Iron Valiant is another great teammate for Keldeo, outspeeding the likes of Choice Specs Dragapult, Choice Band Roaring Moon, and non-Choice Scarf Meowscarada when equipped with a Choice Scarf. Its mixed sets work well with Keldeo, softening each other's checks while wearing down shared checks like Toxapex. Choice Scarf Sneasler is a fast pivot for Fighting teams with U-turn, and it can aid Keldeo in its wallbreaking with its great status spreading abilities thanks to a combination of Dire Claw and Poison Touch. Sneasler can also take out faster threats that annoy Keldeo such as Meowscarada, the Ogerpon formes, and Iron Valiant. In return, Keldeo is able to remove the Ground-types that annoy Sneasler such as Unaware Clodsire and Great Tusk. Gallade is another great teammate due to its ability to break down Poison teams. Lastly, Keldeo's wallbreaking abilities open up room for sweepers like Zamazenta and Iron Valiant to clean late-game, the two of them also appreciating Keldeo removing walls such as Corviknight.

strategies.outdated: This analysis has outdated information / Banned mons
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Fighting (Choice Specs)

Air Slash provides Keldeo coverage against Grass-types such as Amoonguss and Sinistcha; however, the two of them are the only real targets of Air Slash, and Grass teams usually find ways to play around Keldeo.

Fighting (Calm Mind)

Black Belt is an alternative, granting an OHKO versus Meowscarada after a Calm Mind with Vacuum Wave. It can also OHKO 252 HP Hoopa with +1 Sacred Sword and Choice Scarf Iron Treads with +1 Vacuum Wave after Stealth Rock chip, making it a very difficult Pokemon to revenge in the Steel and Dark matchups.

movesets.name: Calm Mind (Fighting)
movesets.description:
With Calm Mind; Keldeo can break through the bulkiest of threats such as Archaludon while also dealing heavy damage on Gouging Fire and Ursaluna-B. Keldeo is also able to outspeed Landorus. Secret Sword is Keldeo's best way to break through even the bulkiest of the metagame such as Blissey and Hisuian Goodra, and Keldeo can take advantage of Secret Sword by boosting it with Calm Mind and hitting them on their physical defensive side. Surf threatens Ground-types such as Landorus, Ursaluna-B, Gliscor, and Hippowdon while dealing with physical walls like Skarmory, which Fighting has a difficult time facing. Along with breaking through bulky Pokemon such as Corviknight, Ting-Lu, and Heatran. Vacuum Wave gets rid of faster threats that outspeed Keldeo such as Chien-Pao and Meowscarada. Heavy-Duty Boots keeps Keldeo safe from getting chipped by entry hazards, as removal is very difficult for Fighting.

Great Tusk is an amazing defensive teammate for Keldeo, providing an Electric immunity and the ability to not only set up Stealth Rock but also use Taunt opposing Defoggers, allowing its entry hazards to chip foes. Great Tusk can take out opposing threats to Keldeo such as Iron Hands, Toxapex, and Clodsire. Assault Vest Iron Hands grants coverage against Flying. With its high HP stat and tremendous bulk; it can remove the likes of Enamorus, Gyarados, and Tornadus-T. Choice Scarf Iron Valiant can outspeed Choice Scarf Latias, Choice Specs Greninja, and non-Choice Scarf Dragapult. Iron Valiant can also run a mixed set that gives more coverage to further assist Keldeo by outspeeding the Ogerpon formes and picking up suprise KOs by not being locked into a single move. Choice Scarf Sneasler is an alternative option to pair with Keldeo, as it can use U-turn against threats such as Gliscor and Great Tusk that Keldeo can take advantage of. With Dire Claw, Sneasler can potentially spread status on problematic foes such as Hatterene and Flutter Mane. Sneasler also outspeeds threats to Keldeo such as the Ogerpon formes and Iron Valiant. Choice Band Zamazenta can assist in breaking through faster Pokemon like Choice Specs Greninja and Choice Specs Latios, while its Substitute + Iron Defense set can safely set up and break down teams. Gallade is a unique teammate for Keldeo as well, as it's able to break down Poison teams, a matchup where Keldeo struggles quite a lot.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 3 onwards

Price Range: 13-14 points

Overview: Keldeo is a powerful special wallbreaker, offensive pivot, and setup sweeper thanks to its powerful STAB moves, excellent Special Attack, good Speed, and ability to hit special walls with Secret Sword. Its typing also allows it to act as a defensive check to dangerous Dark- and Ice-type Pokemon in the format. However, Keldeo struggles to break past Pokemon that resist its STAB moves due to having very limited and weak coverage options. It also offers very few utility options, making it harder to fit into drafts due to its poor role compression.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Wallbreaker: With the help of Choice Specs or another damage-boosting item, Keldeo's Water- and Fighting-type STAB moves can rip through many defensive cores. Access to Secret Sword allows Keldeo to hit both physically and specially, making it harder to defensively check, and a powerful Vacuum Wave also allows it to beat many frail offensive Pokemon that would be faster than it.

Offensive Pivot: Thanks to Flip Turn, a good defensive typing with moderate bulk, and powerful moves that tend to force foes to switch, Keldeo can act as an effective offensive pivot. Additionally, thanks to Keldeo's good Speed, especially if paired with a Choice Scarf, it can also be a powerful revenge killer.

Setup Sweeper: With its good Speed stat, Keldeo can use Calm Mind to be an effective late-game cleaner. Against more offensive drafts, Trailblaze is an option to outspeed an opponent's threats if the extra coverage or power boost from another setup move isn't necessary. Work Up is also a viable alternative in specific matchups, as Keldeo can run a mixed set to make use of its wider physical coverage and beat certain Pokemon that would normally check it.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Surf, Hydro Pump, Secret Sword, Aura Sphere, Focus Blast, Vacuum Wave

Setup Moves: Calm Mind, Trailblaze, Work Up, Substitute

Utility Moves: Flip Turn, Taunt, Brick Break, Reflect

Coverage: Icy Wind, Air Slash, Stone Edge, Poison Jab, X-Scissor

Niche Moves

Swords Dance: Keldeo has a good amount of strong physical STAB options and coverage moves, so a physical set with Swords Dance can be effective in certain scenarios against drafts that would otherwise be difficult for a special Keldeo to break through, such as against special walls that resist Secret Sword. For such sets, your STAB moves of choice are generally Liquidation and Close Combat.

Rain Dance: While normally outclassed by Calm Mind or another setup option, Rain Dance can be useful in a matchup against sun teams by denying their weather while also boosting its Water-type attacks.

Aqua Jet: While Keldeo has a much lower Attack in comparison to its Special Attack, Aqua Jet can be an option to revenge kill weakened Pokemon that are resistant to Vacuum Wave.

Common Items

Choice Specs: Choice Specs allows Keldeo to do massive damage without needing to set up. This lets it act as a strong wallbreaker while also boosting Vacuum Wave so that it can more effectively revenge kill weakened foes.

Choice Scarf: Choice Scarf allows Keldeo to act as great speed control and lets it revenge kill many offensive threats, including many setup sweepers after a Speed boost.

Leftovers: Leftovers is Keldeo's only source of recovery and is mostly useful for Calm Mind sets, allowing Keldeo to stay on the field for longer periods of time.

Heavy-Duty Boots: If Keldeo is being used as an offensive pivot, Heavy-Duty Boots allows it to minimize damage from entry hazards, prolonging its longevity and ability to check key offensive threats.

Niche Items

Damage-boosting Items: Other damage-boosting items, such as Life Orb, or items that boost one of Keldeo's STAB types, can be used as a weaker alternative to Choice Specs on wallbreaking sets or on Calm Mind sets that need a power boost to break through specific defensive checks.

Assault Vest: Keldeo can utilize an Assault Vest, alongside its decent natural bulk, good defensive typing, and strong STAB moves, to act as a check to certain special attackers such as Greninja, Iron Moth, and Terapagos. Keldeo's lack of recovery and vulnerability to entry hazards, however, means that Assault Vest sets can eventually be chipped down and overwhelmed by said attackers.

Salac Berry: Salac Berry can be used alongside Substitute or Endure, mainly on Calm Mind sets, to give Keldeo a Speed boost and allow it to more effectively sweep late-game.

Resistance Berries: Resistance Berries can allow Keldeo to avoid being revenge killed and lure in and defeat its checks. Calm Mind sets in particular can also use them to gain more setup opportunities.

Tera

Keldeo greatly benefits from Tera, but it should not be your first choice for a Tera captain and should be chosen only if your higher-tier Pokemon do not benefit as much from or cannot use Tera. Tera Water and Fighting are great options to boost Keldeo's STAB moves and its wallbreaking potential. Other good options would be Tera types that can utilize Tera Blast to deal with Pokemon that would wall Keldeo's STAB options, such as Tera Electric to allow it to hit Toxapex and Tera Fairy to hit Latias.

Draft Strategy

Keldeo is a good option for both offensive and balanced drafts that are looking for a powerful special wallbreaker that can also act as an offensive pivot or provide decent speed control. Keldeo greatly struggles with Pokemon that resist both of its STAB types, so having teammates that can deal with such Pokemon is essential for maximizing Keldeo's potential as a wallbreaker or setup sweeper.

Speed Control: Having faster teammates that can fulfill the role of speed control allows Keldeo to run its powerful wallbreaker or setup sweeper sets. Pokemon such as Tornadus-T and Meowscarada are great partners for this, as they can pivot into Keldeo with U-turn and provide good utility through Knock Off.

Other Wallbreakers: Pokemon such as Chi-Yu, Urshifu-S, and Raging Bolt can be great partners for Keldeo, as they can break through most Pokemon that would wall Keldeo, while Keldeo can use Flip Turn to better position these wallbreakers and allow them to break apart opposing teams. They can enable Keldeo to have more flexibility with its set, letting it run more restricting items like Choice Scarf with less downsides.

Entry Hazard Removal: Entry hazards—Spikes and Toxic Spikes in particular—greatly reduce Keldeo's longevity and hurt its ability to switch into Pokemon that it could otherwise check. Pokemon that can reliably remove hazards, such as Iron Treads, Excadrill, and even cheaper removal options such as Talonflame, are greatly appreciated.

Entry Hazard Setters: As with most wallbreakers, Keldeo greatly appreciates entry hazard support that can chip down opposing walls and allow it to more easily break through them. Pokemon such as Ting-Lu, Landorus-T, or Jirachi can fulfill this role while also supporting Keldeo by taking on types it is weak to or pivoting into it.

Checks and Counters

Water- and Fighting-resistant Pokemon: Keldeo has poor options for coverage, so Pokemon that resist its STAB moves such as Latias, Primarina, and Amoonguss can easily switch into it and threaten to OHKO or weaken it. Very specially bulky Pokemon that resist Fighting such as Scream Tail, Cresselia, and Uxie are also strong checks to Keldeo, as they take little damage from Secret Sword and can wall Keldeo's other special moves with ease.

Faster Pokemon: Fast Pokemon that aren't weak to Fighting such as Latios, Iron Valiant, and Thundurus naturally outspeed Keldeo and can OHKO it while taking little damage from Vacuum Wave. Opposing Choice Scarf users are also effective at revenge killing Keldeo or forcing it out, as it is outsped by most of them if it does not have a Speed boost itself. Choice Specs Keldeo sets in particular are especially prone to being revenge killed this way if they are not Choice-locked into Vacuum Wave.

Grass-types: Pokemon such as Ogerpon-W, Serperior, and Hydrapple can easily switch into Keldeo's Water-type STAB moves and threaten to OHKO it, though they do not appreciate switching into a Fighting-type move or Air Slash. Rillaboom deserves a special mention, as its above average bulk and additional recovery from Grassy Terrain allow it to potentially switch into Keldeo multiple times throughout a match, and Grassy Glide allows it to easily OHKO Keldeo with little risk.

movesets.name: Choice Specs
movesets.description: Choice Specs Keldeo leverages its fantastic offensive and defensive typing to be a reliable wallbreaker, capable of threatening defensive staples like Celesteela, Scizor, and Tyranitar while taking little from their attacks. Hydro Pump is generally preferred on Keldeo, OHKOing Buzzwole and Scizor after Stealth Rock and having odds to 2HKO defensive Celesteela. Surf hits similarly hard, and while it misses these damage thresholds, it provides greater consistency and more PP; this is particularly notable against Celesteela, which can waste Hydro Pump PP with Protect. Air Slash 2HKOes Mega Venusaur and Amoonguss, while Flip Turn is an option alongside Pursuit users like Tyranitar and Bisharp, as they can threaten the aforementioned defensive options as well as other answers to Keldeo like Slowking and Mega Latias. Toxic is an alternative on teams without Pursuit to cripple checks like Slowking and Mega Latias, but it significantly hinders Keldeo's matchup against Mega Venusaur and Amoonguss, making it a niche option. Vacuum Wave provides Keldeo with powerful priority that is able to pick off faster threats like Sand Rush Excadrill as well as weakened targets like Iron Boulder and Mega Aerodactyl. Keldeo is typically seen on offense and sand teams looking for a powerful special attacker that can shore up weaknesses to offensive threats like Mienshao and Iron Boulder. Sand teams in particular utilize Keldeo well, as Tyranitar can Pursuit trap Slowking and Mega Latias with Pursuit and provides sand, preventing Synthesis Mega Venusaur from being a reliable long-term check to Keldeo. Keldeo in return can help force damage onto Rotom-W and handle physical walls like Skarmory and Buzzwole. While Keldeo is powerful, it can struggle against teams with multiple Pokemon resistant or immune to its STAB attacks, which include defensive options such as Mega Venusaur, Slowking, and Mega Latias. It can also be outsped quite easily by the offensive metagame, which consists of Pokemon such as Iron Moth, Iron Boulder, and Mega Aerodactyl. For these reasons, teammates like Scizor and Mienshao are appreciated for their ability to pressure shared checks, use Knock Off to remove important held items like Leftovers from Aegislash and Celesteela, and provide offensive answers to these Pokemon that threaten Keldeo. Teammates like Iron Moth and Zeraora work similarly, pivoting Keldeo in against Ground- and Grass-type Pokemon that it can threaten. Swampert, Skarmory, and Celesteela help provide Keldeo's team with a defensive backbone against options like Iron Boulder and Clefable, with the former two able to set entry hazards to wear down many of its checks.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description: Calm Mind Keldeo is a fantastic wallbreaker, its formidable offensive typing and ability to run a variety of mixed attacking sets enable it to be a threat against balanced or stall teams, making it an effective setup sweeper versus the likes of Swampert, Tyranitar, and Celesteela. Scald is an excellent Water-type STAB move for Keldeo, as it can burn foes and make it easier to wear down physical attackers like Scizor and Mega Gallade. Hydro Pump, though having lower accuracy, is best used in tandem with Waterium Z to OHKO Swampert after a Calm Mind boost while threatening a KO on both Buzzwole and Scizor with an unboosted Hydro Vortex. Secret Sword is Keldeo's preferred Fighting-type STAB attack, as it hits common pivots to special attacks like Blissey. Substitute, when paired with Leftovers, helps Keldeo set up on defensive switch-ins like Slowking, Gastrodon, and Celesteela. Alternatively, Air Slash could be used for coverage against threatening Grass-type foes and gives Keldeo the ability to run Flyinium Z to OHKO the likes of Hydrapple and Mega Venusaur after a boost. Alternatively, Taunt can be used to prevent bulky Pokemon like Slowbro and Aegislash from spreading status. With this much wallbreaking power, Keldeo is seen on more offensive teams that are lacking in checks against the likes of Scizor and Greninja. Although Keldeo can be seen as a wallbreaking threat, many teams can utilize Pokemon that aren't weak to either STAB attack such as Mega Venusaur and Slowking. There are also quite a few Pokemon that can outspeed and threaten Keldeo such as Zeraora, Iron Boulder, and Serperior. Teamates such as Scizor and Mienshao help against these faster threats and can assist greatly by pressuring checks to Keldeo like Aegislash and Celesteela by removing their Leftovers while also being able to efficiently pivot out with U-turn. In return, Keldeo assists both by pressuring physical walls like Skarmory and Mandibuzz. Teammates that can provide entry hazard support such as Tyranitar and Clefable are appreciated by Keldeo, as chip from entry hazards makes it easier to threaten a OHKO on physical walls. Faster teammates such as Iron Moth and Zeraora can be excellent in baiting in Ground-type threats and pivoting back into Keldeo for more offensive pressure. In return, Keldeo removes Ground-type threats like Excadrill and Hippowdon to make it easier for both to pivot reliably.

movesets.name: Choice Specs (Fighting)
movesets.description: Keldeo stands out as Fighting team's premier Choice Specs user, leveraging its solid typing and unique toolkit to easily break past physical walls such as Mega Sableye and Gliscor that often cause issues for Fighting teams. Hydro Pump is Keldeo's strongest attack, washing away Ground- and Fire-types like the Landorus formes, Great Tusk, and Skeledirge with ease. Secret Sword enables Keldeo to break special walls such as Blissey and Hisuian Goodra that would otherwise wall it. Vacuum Wave serves as a Fighting team's main form of priority, being used to pick off weakened targets such as Sand Rush Excadrill and Meowscarada, which can be a nuisance to Fighting teams. Finally, Keldeo can use Icy Wind to immediately remove threats such as Garchomp and Latios in a pinch. Alternatively, Scald can be used as a completely accurate Water-type STAB move in situations where Hydro Pump's higher power isn't needed, while Hidden Power Electric enables Keldeo to break past Pelipper and Mantine. Iron Hands serves as an excellent partner to Keldeo, as it is able to break through Water-types that can handle Keldeo such as Tapu Fini and Toxapex along with taking on faster Flying-types like Tornadus-T and Mega Pidgeot; in return, it appreciates Keldeo breaking Ground-types such as Gliscor and Great Tusk. Mega Gallade can break through problematic threats that can easily take on Keldeo such as Mega Venusaur and Water Absorb Clodsire, which otherwise wall Keldeo. Iron Valiant deals with Dragon-type threats such as Kommo-o, Mega Altaria, and Latias along with using coverage moves like Shadow Ball to beat Sinistcha. Breloom and Hisuian Lilligant both assist Keldeo by breaking down Water-types like Swampert and Greninja and appreciate Keldeo handling Fire-types like Torkoal and Ceruledge. Great Tusk provides Rapid Spin and Stealth Rock support, enabling Keldeo to get in safely while chipping down switch-ins like Assault Vest Iron Hands, and its Ground typing enables it to handle Electric-types such as Regieleki and Raging Bolt. Sneasler is a fast teammate that can handle Fairy- and Grass-types like Iron Valiant, Tapu Bulu, and Breloom.
